content:
Extract the invoice data from the document below into JSON with exactly this schema:

{
  "vendor_name": "string",
  "invoice_number": "string",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null if not applicable",
  "currency": "3-letter ISO code",
  "subtotal": 0.00,
  "tax_amount": 0.00,
  "total": 0.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "string", "quantity": 0, "unit_price": 0.00, "amount": 0.00}
  ]
}

Note: subtotal means all pre-tax charges (including shipping and after discounts).

Return only the JSON object, nothing else.

DOCUMENT:
FAIRVIEW TRADING PTE LTD
71 Kaki Bukit Ave 1, Singapore 417943
GST Reg No: 201503998M

TAX INVOICE

Invoice No : FT-8814
Date       : 23/04/2025
Due        : 07/05/2025 (Net 14)
Currency   : SGD

Sold To: Banyan Interiors LLP

--------------------------------------------------------------
 DESCRIPTION                      QTY    UNIT PRICE     AMOUNT
--------------------------------------------------------------
 Rattan lounge chair               8       62.50        500.00
 Teak coffee table                 2      240.00        480.00
--------------------------------------------------------------
                                        Subtotal:       980.00
                                        GST (9%):        88.20
                                        TOTAL:        $1,068.20

Goods remain property of Fairview Trading Pte Ltd until paid in full.

```json
{
  "vendor_name": "FAIRVIEW TRADING PTE LTD",
  "invoice_number": "FT-8814",
  "invoice_date": "2025-04-23",
  "due_date": "2025-05-07",
  "currency": "SGD",
  "subtotal": 980.00,
  "tax_amount": 88.20,
  "total": 1068.20,
  "line_items": [
    {
      "description": "Rattan lounge chair",
      "quantity": 8,
      "unit_price": 62.50,
      "amount": 500.00
    },
    {
      "description": "Teak coffee table",
      "quantity": 2,
      "unit_price": 240.00,
      "amount": 480.00
    }
  ]
}
```
